## F30A plan review and claim

F30A `herby-crude-rat` received a signed PASS against `e48142648445e6f947e46183a99097bfdbc45366` and was claimed as `joeoakhart@navapbc.com`. Two reviews from linked worktrees failed with the confirmed `origin/tickets` ref race tracked by `agrologic-oval-bobolink`. The `rebar-debug` duplicate gate found that open bug and no new bug was created. A disposable clone with a distinct Git common directory and the required explicit tickets refspec completed the review without the ref race.

The review advised two accuracy checks. The documentation must not present ADR 0098 design names `GitRuntime` or `BridgeRuntime` as implemented classes. Each prose claim about authentication carriers, ownership enforcement, and non-universal authority will be checked against source evidence and focused contract tests. The review attestation is current on the F30A worktree. The isolated review emitted three unsigned ticket-event authorship warnings because that clone lacked the checkout writer identity. The plan-review attestation itself reports `signed`.
